metadata.description: Game hardware requirements, optimization features, and performance information.

data.title: Cyberpunk 2077

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-6700 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB or Intel Arc A380

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-12700 or AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or Intel Arc A770

data.vram_usage: 6 GB minimum, 8 GB recommended for higher settings
optimization_notes: SSD strongly recommended
Ray tracing substantially increases GPU demand
Frame generation can improve performance on supported hardware

data.title: Alan Wake 2

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD equivalent
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT

recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT

data.vram_usage: 8 GB or more recommended for higher settings
optimization_notes: SSD required
Full ray tracing is extremely demanding
Upscaling is strongly recommended on higher settings

data.title: Black Myth: Wukong

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or Intel Arc A750

data.vram_usage: 6 GB minimum, 8 GB or more recommended
optimization_notes: SSD recommended
Upscaling is supported across major GPU vendors
Ray tracing significantly increases GPU demand

data.title: Starfield

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-6800K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-10600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 or AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT

optimization_notes: SSD required
Large open-world simulation can increase CPU demand
Upscaling can improve performance on mid-range hardware

data.title: Red Dead Redemption 2

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 2GB or AMD Radeon R9 280

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB

optimization_notes: Graphics settings have a large performance range
Higher resolutions increase GPU demand significantly

data.title: Hogwarts Legacy

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470 4GB

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

optimization_notes: SSD improves asset streaming
Ray tracing increases GPU requirements considerably
16 GB RAM is recommended

data.title: Forza Horizon 5

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 470

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX 590

optimization_notes: Wide range of graphics presets
Ray tracing is mainly used in specific modes
Upscaling can improve high-resolution performance

data.title: Baldur's Gate 3

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-4690 or AMD FX 8350
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 480

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

optimization_notes: CPU demand can increase in dense late-game areas
SSD required
Upscaling can help at higher resolutions

data.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 or AMD Radeon RX 570

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 590

data.vram_usage: 4 GB minimum, 8 GB or more recommended
optimization_notes: CPU performance is especially important in dense locations
Fast storage and sufficient RAM improve streaming behavior
Frame generation can significantly increase perceived frame rate

data.title: The Last of Us Part I

minimum_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
minimum_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 470

recommended_requirements.cpu: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
recommended_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT

optimization_notes: SSD required
Shader compilation can affect initial loading
Higher presets can require substantial VRAM
